# Card reference: `solaria.sh/v1alpha1`

Every Solaria file holds one or more YAML documents, each a resource with `apiVersion`, `kind`, `metadata` and `spec`. This page lists every field of each kind. The same rules are in the [JSON Schema](../schemas/v1alpha1/), which `solaria schema` prints for editors.

Paths use `.` for nested fields, `[]` for list items and `<name>` for map keys you choose.

## Agent

Describes an agent independently of the host it runs on.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiVersion` | `solaria.sh/v1alpha1` | yes | API version of this resource. |
| `kind` | `Agent` | yes | Kind of this resource. |
| `metadata` | object | yes | Identifies the agent. |
| `metadata.name` | string | yes | Unique name per kind. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit, at most 63 characters. Matches `^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$`. |
| `metadata.labels` | map of strings |  | Labels for selecting resources, for example from an Environment's agents.selector. |
| `spec` | object | yes | Describes the agent. |
| `spec.description` | string |  | What the agent is for. Hosts that list agents show it. |
| `spec.instructions` | list of strings | yes | Markdown files, relative to this file, joined in order to form the system prompt. At least 1. |
| `spec.model` | object | yes | The model the agent uses. |
| `spec.model.preferred` | string | yes | Preferred model, as provider:model, for example anthropic:claude-sonnet-5-5. Matches `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*:[^ ]+$`. |
| `spec.model.fallback` | list of strings |  | Fallback models, tried in order on hosts that support fallback. Each matches `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*:[^ ]+$`. |
| `spec.model.effort` | `low` or `medium` or `high` or `xhigh` or `max` |  | How much reasoning the model should spend. Providers map it to the closest setting their host has. |
| `spec.tools` | object |  | Tools the agent may use. |
| `spec.tools.builtin` | list of `shell` or `read` or `write` or `edit` or `glob` or `grep` or `web_fetch` or `web_search` |  | Builtin tools, by Solaria's host-neutral names. Providers map them to their host's own tools. |
| `spec.tools.mcp` | list of objects |  | MCP servers the agent uses, by reference to McpServer resources. |
| `spec.tools.mcp[].ref` | string | yes | Name of an McpServer resource. |
| `spec.tools.mcp[].allowTools` | list of strings |  | The server's tools this agent may call. When omitted, every tool the server offers is allowed. At least 1. |
| `spec.skills` | list of strings |  | Paths to Agent Skills folders, relative to this file. Each folder holds a SKILL.md. |
| `spec.permissions` | object |  | Narrows how the agent may use its tools. |
| `spec.permissions.ask` | list of strings |  | Tools that need a person's approval before each call: a builtin name, or server/tool for an MCP tool. On hosts without approvals in unattended runs, these tools are denied, and plan says so. |
| `spec.limits` | object |  | Bounds each run of the agent. |
| `spec.limits.maxTurns` | integer |  | Most model calls in one run. |
| `spec.limits.timeout` | string |  | Longest a run may take, as a duration such as 30m or 1h30m. Matches `^([0-9]+(h\|m\|s))+$`. |
| `spec.providers` | map of objects |  | Fields passed unchanged to one provider, keyed by provider name. Using them makes the agent less portable, and validate reports it. |

## Environment

Describes where and how agents run.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiVersion` | `solaria.sh/v1alpha1` | yes | API version of this resource. |
| `kind` | `Environment` | yes | Kind of this resource. |
| `metadata` | object | yes | Identifies the environment. |
| `metadata.name` | string | yes | Unique name per kind. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit, at most 63 characters. Matches `^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$`. |
| `metadata.labels` | map of strings |  | Labels for selecting resources, for example from an Environment's agents.selector. |
| `spec` | object | yes | Describes the environment. |
| `spec.provider` | string | yes | Who runs the agent loop, for example gitagent or managed-agents. Matches `^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$`. |
| `spec.placement` | string | yes | Where the provider's sandbox lives, for example docker, cloud or self-hosted. Matches `^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$`. |
| `spec.agents` | object |  | Which agents this environment receives. When omitted, it receives every agent. |
| `spec.agents.selector` | object | yes | Matches agents by label. |
| `spec.agents.selector.matchLabels` | map of strings | yes | Selects resources that have all these labels. |
| `spec.sandbox` | object |  | The machine the agents' tools run on. |
| `spec.sandbox.packages` | object |  | Packages to install, by package manager, in each manager's own pin syntax. |
| `spec.sandbox.packages.apt` | list of strings |  | APT packages. |
| `spec.sandbox.packages.cargo` | list of strings |  | Cargo crates. |
| `spec.sandbox.packages.gem` | list of strings |  | Ruby gems. |
| `spec.sandbox.packages.go` | list of strings |  | Go modules, installed with go install. |
| `spec.sandbox.packages.npm` | list of strings |  | npm packages, installed globally. |
| `spec.sandbox.packages.pip` | list of strings |  | pip packages. |
| `spec.sandbox.network` | object |  | Outbound network access. When omitted, access is limited to the hosts the agents need. |
| `spec.sandbox.network.mode` | `limited` or `unrestricted` |  | limited (only allowed hosts) or unrestricted. |
| `spec.sandbox.network.allow` | list of strings |  | Extra hosts the sandbox may reach in limited mode. Each matches `^(\*\.)?[A-Za-z0-9]([-A-Za-z0-9]*[A-Za-z0-9])?(\.[A-Za-z0-9]([-A-Za-z0-9]*[A-Za-z0-9])?)*$`. |
| `spec.sandbox.network.packageManagers` | boolean |  | Allows the package managers' registries in limited mode. |
| `spec.sandbox.resources` | object |  | Memory and disk caps, where the placement allows them. |
| `spec.sandbox.resources.memory` | string |  | Memory cap, such as 8Gi. Matches `^[0-9]+(Ki\|Mi\|Gi\|Ti)?$`. |
| `spec.sandbox.resources.disk` | string |  | Disk cap, such as 10Gi. Matches `^[0-9]+(Ki\|Mi\|Gi\|Ti)?$`. |
| `spec.sandbox.image` | string |  | Replaces the generated sandbox image: a container image reference, or a path to a Dockerfile relative to this file. Only container placements accept it. |
| `spec.secrets` | object |  | Where secret values are read from when applying. |
| `spec.secrets.source` | `env` or `dotenv` | yes | env (the process environment) or dotenv (a .env file). |
| `spec.secrets.path` | string |  | Path of the dotenv file, relative to this file. Defaults to .env. |
| `spec.telemetry` | object |  | Where agents send OpenTelemetry data. |
| `spec.telemetry.endpoint` | string | yes | URL of an OTLP receiver, such as http://localhost:4318. A URI. |
| `spec.telemetry.protocol` | `grpc` or `http/protobuf` |  | OTLP protocol. Defaults to http/protobuf. |
| `spec.telemetry.headers` | list of objects |  | Headers sent with every export. |
| `spec.telemetry.headers[].name` | string | yes | Name of the header or variable. |
| `spec.telemetry.headers[].value` | string |  | Value, when it isn't secret. |
| `spec.telemetry.headers[].secretRef` | string |  | Name of a secret in the environment's secret source, in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. Its value is never stored by Solaria. Matches `^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$`. |
| `spec.overrides` | map of objects |  | Changes to agents in this environment only, keyed by agent name. |
| `spec.overrides.<name>.model` | object |  | Model fields to replace. |
| `spec.overrides.<name>.model.preferred` | string |  | Preferred model, as provider:model. Matches `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*:[^ ]+$`. |
| `spec.overrides.<name>.model.fallback` | list of strings |  | Fallback models, replacing the agent's list. Each matches `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*:[^ ]+$`. |
| `spec.overrides.<name>.model.effort` | `low` or `medium` or `high` or `xhigh` or `max` |  | Effort level. |
| `spec.overrides.<name>.limits` | object |  | Limits to replace. |
| `spec.overrides.<name>.limits.maxTurns` | integer |  | Most model calls in one run. |
| `spec.overrides.<name>.limits.timeout` | string |  | Longest a run may take, as a duration such as 30m or 1h30m. Matches `^([0-9]+(h\|m\|s))+$`. |
| `spec.overrides.<name>.providers` | map of objects |  | Providers fields to merge over the agent's own. |
| `spec.providers` | map of objects |  | Settings for the environment's provider, keyed by provider name, such as the platform gitagent builds images for. Each provider documents its own settings. They describe the host, not the agents, so they aren't part of any agent's digest. |

## McpServer

Offers one or more ways to reach an MCP server. Each provider picks one its placement supports.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apiVersion` | `solaria.sh/v1alpha1` | yes | API version of this resource. |
| `kind` | `McpServer` | yes | Kind of this resource. |
| `metadata` | object | yes | Identifies the server. |
| `metadata.name` | string | yes | Unique name per kind. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit, at most 63 characters. Matches `^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$`. |
| `metadata.labels` | map of strings |  | Labels for selecting resources, for example from an Environment's agents.selector. |
| `spec` | object | yes | Describes how to reach the server. |
| `spec.description` | string |  | Description of the server. |
| `spec.packages` | list of objects |  | Packages that run the server locally, inside the sandbox, over stdio. At least 1. |
| `spec.packages[].registryType` | `npm` or `pypi` | yes | Package registry: npm or pypi. |
| `spec.packages[].identifier` | string | yes | Package name in its registry. |
| `spec.packages[].version` | string | yes | Exact package version. |
| `spec.packages[].transport` | object | yes | Transport the package speaks. |
| `spec.packages[].transport.type` | `stdio` | yes | Always stdio. |
| `spec.packages[].packageArguments` | list of objects |  | Arguments passed to the server when it starts. |
| `spec.packages[].packageArguments[].type` | `positional` or `named` | yes | positional or named. |
| `spec.packages[].packageArguments[].name` | string |  | Name of a named argument, such as --port. |
| `spec.packages[].packageArguments[].value` | string | yes | Value of the argument. |
| `spec.packages[].environmentVariables` | list of objects |  | Environment variables set for the server process. |
| `spec.packages[].environmentVariables[].name` | string | yes | Name of the header or variable. |
| `spec.packages[].environmentVariables[].value` | string |  | Value, when it isn't secret. |
| `spec.packages[].environmentVariables[].secretRef` | string |  | Name of a secret in the environment's secret source, in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. Its value is never stored by Solaria. Matches `^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$`. |
| `spec.remotes` | list of objects |  | Endpoints to connect to. At least 1. |
| `spec.remotes[].type` | `streamable-http` or `sse` | yes | Remote transport: streamable-http or sse. |
| `spec.remotes[].url` | string | yes | URL of the endpoint. A URI. |
| `spec.remotes[].headers` | list of objects |  | Headers sent with every request. |
| `spec.remotes[].headers[].name` | string | yes | Name of the header or variable. |
| `spec.remotes[].headers[].value` | string |  | Value, when it isn't secret. |
| `spec.remotes[].headers[].secretRef` | string |  | Name of a secret in the environment's secret source, in UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. Its value is never stored by Solaria. Matches `^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$`. |
